notes.title: Switch 2 Launch Celebration! Rumble Burst Release Kicks Off Immediately!"
notes.notes:
[p]Sure! Here's a natural and enthusiastic English version suitable for announcing on X (formerly Twitter):[/p][hr][/hr][p]As announced on X, I was lucky enough to win a Switch 2!
To celebrate, I’ve officially launched [b]Rumble Burst[/b]! 🎉✨[/p][p]Please check it out and enjoy!
One day, it's my dream to release a game from the [i]Unreally[/i] series on Switch 2.[/p][p]Thank you so much for your continued support! 💖[/p]
